description:
This record contains the code, stored results and analysis scripts for the paper "From Regime Shift to Redundancy: Boundary Conditions for Swarm-Based Feature Selection".

The code extends Orthogonal Particle Swarm Optimisation with Crossover (OrPSOC) to non-stationary data, adding self-triggered and detector-triggered adaptation. It compares OrPSOC with an all-features baseline, four other swarm-based selectors (correlation-guided PSO, Taguchi chaotic binary PSO, hybrid PSO/differential evolution and binary whale optimisation) and three filter or embedded selectors (mRMR, LASSO and RFE), all under the same walk-forward cross-validation protocol. The experiments cover a synthetic benchmark with known signal features, financial datasets built from public sources, a study of increasing feature dimensionality, a nested cross-validation analysis of the regularisation penalty, a comparison of regime-change detectors and two non-financial benchmarks.

Files:

  • ADAPTIVE_WRAPPER_RESEARCH-v1.0.0.zip: the repository at tag v1.0.0, with code, stored results, tables and figures. Most tables and figures regenerate from it in about a minute.
  • Five .tgz archives of per-run checkpoints (model outputs only, no data values). A few results need them; scripts/rebuild_from_deposit.sh unpacks them and re-renders everything. The README lists the contents and SHA-256 checksum of each archive.

Reproducibility notes: The datasets are not redistributed. They are rebuilt from public sources that revise their history, so a fresh download may not reproduce the stored values bit for bit. RFE results also depend on the platform and the data download. The checkpoints behind one synthetic panel (Table 8a) were lost; the archived ones are a recomputation that reproduces it exactly. The README records where each result was computed and which results could not be re-run on the reference data copy.
